principle_violations.reason: The AreaCalculator class is responsible for both computing areas and validating shapes, while VolumeCalculator extends it but does not differentiate its responsibility clearly.
principle_violations.suggestion: Separate the validation logic from the area calculation. Consider creating a dedicated class for shape validation.

principle_violations.reason: The sum method in VolumeCalculator does not accommodate different types of volume calculations, violating the open/closed principle.
principle_violations.suggestion: Consider creating an interface for 3D shapes and extend the logic to different shape types without altering the existing sum method.
